l2py1dipvbj.title: CUSTOMERS LOVE OUR ICE MAKER KITS
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahjacp_des_html: <!--lh-live-editor-->OMGooooodness. Everything you need! Love it! Had my doubts, but everything fit perfectly, long enough tubing, fitting seems sturdy enough... For the first time ever, I have cool filtered water and ice from a refrigerator door ;-) I only had to remove everything from the bottom cabinets, slide the fridge out, slide the oven out, drill holes through the back and bottoms of 6 cabinets, and hook up the fitting under the sink.... and then put everything back LOL Seriously, Thank You for having the correct needs.
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahj7ag_des_html: After failing to find what I needed from multiple big box hardware stores I found this item and in 24 hours it was delivered. Installed in about 45 minutes (drilling holes in cabinets and moving my refrigerator to get to back). My only issue was trying to remember which direction the open valve was in (parallel with tube). Added an inline filter and now I have plenty of clean ice.<!--lh-live-editor-->
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahj487_des_html: I have no real plumbing experience. After having a plumber install a new sink and replace the shutoffs, I realized that the with the price I was charged I could totally screw everything up multiple times and still come out cheaper than the plumbers in my area. So, because the plumbers didn't have the parts to hook my fridge line back up, I watched a couple of videos online, bought this thing, and did it myself. It's been installed now for a month or two. No leaks. Everything works as it should and I'm very happy. Saved myself hundreds of bucks too.<!--lh-live-editor-->
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahj15y_title: Easy to install and doesn't feel cheap
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahj15y_des_html: Easy and doesn't feel cheaply made. That is the hallmark of a good product. Great deal for the money in 2023. Can't say what the price will be in 2024.<!--lh-live-editor-->
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahiy3p_des_html: Everything you need comes in the kit. I found a video in YouTube that walks you step by step on installation. We finally have ice and water from out fridge!<!--lh-live-editor-->
l2py1dipvbj.lh_ahiv1g_des_html: This kit was perfect to install the icemaker/water dispenser on my new fridge. I'm enjoying the ice and water. Recommended.<!--lh-live-editor-->

phYHc6b50M.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mxb_title: How are the Metpure Versatile quick twist filter systems different than other quick twist systems?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mxb_content_html: Our systems are equipped with quick twist filters that can be replaced with ease without any required tools. One of the main differences in our Metpure versatile quick twist systems is that the open design allows for easy troubleshoot, part replacement, and customization. Also, due to this open design concept, we can customize the Metpure Versatile systems to suite many different water filtration needs.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mxa_title: How big is the typical Metpure Versatile water filtration system?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mxa_content_html: Our systems, given similar specs as other systems, take up typically up to 3 times LESS space than our competitors. Combined with our low-profile quick twist filters and open design concept, we are able to design our systems to be much more compact while achieving superior water filtration functions and effectiveness. <!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx9_title: How often should the filters be replaced?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx9_content_html: Filter life span depends heavily on usage, water quality, water pressure, and the type of filters being replaced. Typically, pre-filters can last between 6-12 months, and reverse osmosis membranes can last 2-4 years.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx8_title: What does the Metpure Versatile system come with?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx8_content_html: All pre-packaged systems come with all the required parts for installation, such as tubings, faucet, valves, fittings, tanks, etc, so you don’t have to worry about getting parts separately, costing you extra time and money.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx7_title: What is the warranty on the system?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx7_content_html: All our Metpure Versatile systems come with a 1-year manufactured warranty + 1 additional year upon system registration.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx6_title: Are the Metpure Versatile systems easy to be installed?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx6_content_html: The systems come with a detailed instructional manual and installation videos that can be easily followed step-by-step. Only basic tools are required to install the system. Many first time users and installed find our systems very easy to install.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx5_title: How do I know which system is right for me?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx5_content_html: We detail and list every system and its filter specifications with as much information as possible. Please read through the listing of each system and determine which one suites your need the best. Or contact our customer support at support@metpure.com or call us at 714-202-0019.<!--lh-live-editor-->
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx4_title: How do you customize the Metpure Versatile systems?
phYHc6b50M.lh_ku5mx4_content_html: We can customize the system to your specification with the existing filters and parts available. If you are a business or reseller and would like to private label the Metpure Versatile systems, contact our customer support at support@metpure.com or call us at 714-202-0019 for more information.<!--lh-live-editor-->

5j3dqdxv0zc.title: Our Sediment Filters
5j3dqdxv0zc.des_html: Ensure clean and clear water with the Metpure Sediment Filter Collection. Our carefully curated collection of sediment filters is designed to effectively remove suspended particles, sediment, and impurities from your water supply.<!--lh-live-editor-->

zwuashgf5r.lh_a168_title: DISCOVER THE BENEFITS OF OUR SEDIMENT FILTER
zwuashgf5r.lh_9wid92_lable: Sediment Removal Targeting Impurities at the Source
zwuashgf5r.lh_9wid92_desc_html: The sediment filters utilize a highly efficient, multi-layered filtration system designed to capture and remove even the finest particles suspended in water. Employing a combination of mesh sizes, these filters effectively trap sedimentary impurities, preventing their passage through the filtration media. <!--lh-live-editor-->
zwuashgf5r.lh_a5w0bb_lable: Each Filter Entails Radial Multi-Gradient Structure Technology
zwuashgf5r.lh_a5w0bb_desc_html: Radial Multi-Gradient Structure Technology in sediment filters is an advanced design that optimizes particle removal efficiency. The filter features multiple layers with varying densities arranged in a radial pattern, creating a gradient effect. Larger particles are captured in the outer layers, while smaller ones are progressively filtered as water moves toward the center.<!--lh-live-editor-->

o5mwt1nlbf7.title: Our Carbon Block Filters
o5mwt1nlbf7.des_html: Discover the exceptional filtration capabilities of our Carbon Block Collection, featuring a range of premium water filters designed to elevate your water purification experience. Each filter in this collection is meticulously crafted to deliver superior performance, effectively reducing chlorine, taste, and odor while efficiently eliminating volatile organic carbon compounds, insecticides, pesticides, and solvents.<!--lh-live-editor-->

8itsx5bog6r.lh_a168_title: DISCOVER THE BENEFITS OF OUR CARBON BLOCK FILTER
8itsx5bog6r.lh_9wid92_desc_html: <!--lh-live-editor-->Carbon block filters an array of impurities in the water. As water passes through the dense carbon block, contaminants such as chlorine, bad taste, odor, sediment, and volatile organic compounds are adsorbed onto the carbon surface.
8itsx5bog6r.lh_a5w0bb_lable: Premium Carbon Block Structure and Material
8itsx5bog6r.lh_a5w0bb_desc_html: <!--lh-live-editor-->Our premium carbon block filters employ a specialized porous structure composed of 100% food-grade virgin coconut shell carbon, compacted and extruded in a block form. The filter is then layered with PP fabric and hard plastic end-caps, making them structurally sound and dense.

i618t9tlyxs.lh_a168_title_html: FILTERS WITH SUPERIOR  QUALITY
i618t9tlyxs.lh_ezc4q5_content_html: The thick padded o-rings are manufacturered with food-grade material that is designed to provide tight, sealed connection with the system and prevent water from bypassing the filter.<!--lh-live-editor-->
i618t9tlyxs.lh_ezhhnw_content_html: Metpure's radial flow filtration allows water to enter the cartridge through radius of the filter outside in. The outer mesh first removes and traps large sediment, and the inner 5 micron extruded carbon block removes chlorine, bad taste, and odor.<!--lh-live-editor-->

rrarsw18v5h.lh_9wid92_lable: Inline Coconut Shell Granular Activated Carbon (GAC)
rrarsw18v5h.lh_9wid92_desc_html: GAC inline filters use 100% virgin coconut shell granular activated carbon, effectively removes chlorine, bates taste, and odor from your water, ensuring your drinking water is polished with crisp and clean taste.<!--lh-live-editor-->
rrarsw18v5h.lh_a5w0bb_desc_html: Our GAC inline filters are 2" x 10" long, which universally fits most water filtration support clips on your systems. The inline filters also come in both 1/4" OD and 3/8" OD connection ports, both in quick connect and female thread ends<!--lh-live-editor-->
